data.name: Khalid
data.gender_notes: Khalid is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root خ-ل-د (kh-l-d), 'to be eternal'. Khālid means 'eternal, immortal'. Its root is خ-ل-د (kh-l-d). Borne by Khālid ibn al-Walīd, a famous early Muslim commander. Khalid is a Arabic name meaning “Eternal; immortal; everlasting”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Khalid expresses “Eternal; immortal; everlasting”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root خ-ل-د (kh-l-d), 'to be eternal'. Khālid means 'eternal, immortal'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khalid total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
